intent: Record as reviewed the exposure review, body size and republication rules the publishing Context enforces and tests.
observable_outcome: get-context publishing lists the rules as reviewed, each proven by its test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An exposure review is refused as stale unless it names the current release and the review sequence its reviewer saw.
An approval is refused as stale and records nothing unless it names the search snapshot digest the reviewer saw; a revocation needs no such proof.
An exposure review is refused before any lookup unless its decision is approved or revoked and it carries a non-blank reason.
Every publishing request reads at most 64 KiB of JSON and refuses a longer body with 400.
Publishing the published latest version again, with the same content, adds no release, so its exposure review is kept.
A Skill an operator took down cannot be published; the request is answered not found and no publication is created.
Publishing a Skill with a version of another Skill is answered not found, so one Skill's gates never pass another Skill's files.
Delisting writes an audit event only when it changes the publication, so delisting twice records one delist.
